## Result in one paragraph

The current working model dispatches `ol` to R05 as a contextual field relation, `ols` to R04 as a measure/product field, and `otar` to R05 as a step or field transition. None of those three is an evidence winner: each was chosen by `SPECIFICITY_DISPATCH_PRIORITY_AMONG_EQUAL_GATE_SCORES`. `ol` also has supported R01 nominal-preparation and R03 product/result roles; `ols` has a supported R01 rival; and `otar` has a supported R01 rival. Only `pcheey` has one clearly passing role, R04 bounded preparation/form-II field. `ckhy` remains globally open. The working defaults remain contextual `und/mit/von/aus` for `ol`, `Maß-/Produktposten` for `ols`, and `weiter/dann` for `otar`. These are renderer choices, not confirmed translations or role proofs.

## Provisional dispatch

| Target | Current role decision | Reader default | Confidence carried by the specification | Live rival or limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ol` | R05 selected only by specificity priority among equal passing R05, R01, and R03 scores | `und/mit`; after a quantity, context may instead require `von/aus` | `C1_LOCAL_FRAME__C0_ROLE_TIEBREAK`; C0 lexeme | supported R01 *Ansatz/Zubereitungsbasis* and R03 product/result roles; no liquid identity follows |
| `otar` | R05 selected only by specificity priority over an equally passing R01 role | `dann/anschließend/weiter` | `C1_LOCAL_FRAME__C0_ROLE_TIEBREAK`; C0 lexeme | `bis` is the primary identity rival; nominal preparation/record field is the principal role rival |
| `pcheey` | R04 bounded record/form field | `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld` | C1 replicated role globally; C2 in the specified line readers; C0 form identity | paste, salve, mixed form, or residue remain candidates; dry/powder has no positive frame |
| `ols` | R04 selected only by specificity priority over an equally passing R01 role | before a value: `Maß-/Dosisposten`; line-final: `Endportion`; otherwise `Maß-/Produktposten` | C0 role tiebreak and concrete identity; individual line readers carry C1–C2 local frame evidence | supported R01 substance/preparation role; the measured preparation or product cannot be identified |
| `ckhy` | global role open between R02 operation and R01 nominal preparation | line-final process frame: `mischen/verrühren`; medial content frame: `Mischung/Kompositum` | globally `C0_RIVAL_ONLY`; specified medial readers carry C1 contextual support | no single global process or substance role has won; mediality alone does not make it a linker |

The C-levels are internal working-confidence labels, not probabilities. In particular, C1 or C2 at role level does not promote an English, German, Latin, or Middle English word identity above C0.

### `pcheey`: R04 preparation/form-II field, with zero dry evidence

There are only three exact occurrences, but all three immediately follow `sho` or `sheo`, and two form a `pcheey-X-daiin` construction. All three are medial in paragraph-opening lines. This repeated bounded-field geometry supports R04 and the neutral reader phrase `gebundenes Zubereitungs-/Form-II-Feld`.

The dry frame F03 has zero support. There is also no independent vessel, operation, passage/straining, or closing signal. A previous powder-like reading inherited from the shape of EVA `p` is therefore excluded from the default. Paste, salve, mixed form, or residue after soaking remain possible identities, but none is selected.

1. Zensus und Positionsgeometrie ohne Bedeutung bauen.
2. Alle Bedeutungsgeber durch Targetpanel, GDT754, explizites GDT737-Q80 und
   die gemeinsame ED≤2-Familie sperren.
3. Die 16 festen Rahmensignaturen pro Ziel und locus zählen.
4. Fünf Rollen vergleichen: Nomen/Zubereitung, Vorgang, Produkt, Recordfeld,
   Folgen-/Feldverbinder.
5. Nur innerhalb einer tragfähigen Rolle konkrete Identitätskarten werten.
6. Stärksten stützenden locus entfernen und die notwendige Zwei-Achsen-
   Signatur auf einer zweiten Seite erneut prüfen.
